note: Short verses from the original Hindu, Buddhist, Jain and Sikh scriptures, quoted in their original language and script. English renderings are the project's own plain translations. Themes drive which verse accompanies which chart, map or index.

verses.text: एकं सद्विप्रा बहुधा वदन्ति
verses.english: Truth is one; the wise speak of it in many ways.

verses.text: सं गच्छध्वं सं वदध्वं सं वो मनांसि जानताम्
verses.english: Walk together, speak together, let your minds be of one accord.

verses.text: आ नो भद्राः क्रतवो यन्तु विश्वतः
verses.english: Let noble thoughts come to us from every side.

verses.text: द्यौः शान्तिरन्तरिक्षं शान्तिः पृथिवी शान्तिरापः शान्तिरोषधयः शान्तिः
verses.english: Peace to the sky, peace to the air between, peace to the earth, peace to the waters, peace to the plants.

verses.text: माता भूमिः पुत्रो अहं पृथिव्याः
verses.english: The Earth is my mother, and I am her child.

verses.text: ईशावास्यमिदँ सर्वं यत्किञ्च जगत्यां जगत्। तेन त्यक्तेन भुञ्जीथाः मा गृधः कस्यस्विद्धनम्॥
verses.english: All that moves in this world is pervaded by the Divine. Enjoy it by letting go, and do not covet anyone's wealth.

verses.text: उत्तिष्ठत जाग्रत प्राप्य वरान्निबोधत
verses.english: Arise, awake, and learn by going to those who are worthy.

verses.text: सत्यमेव जयते नानृतम्
verses.english: Truth alone triumphs, not falsehood.

verses.text: सत्यं वद। धर्मं चर। स्वाध्यायान्मा प्रमदः।
verses.english: Speak the truth. Live by dharma. Never neglect your own study.

verses.text: मातृदेवो भव। पितृदेवो भव। आचार्यदेवो भव। अतिथिदेवो भव।
verses.english: Honour your mother, your father, your teacher and your guest as the Divine.

verses.text: शं नो मित्रः शं वरुणः। शं नो भवत्वर्यमा।
verses.english: May Mitra be kind to us, may Varuna, lord of the waters, be kind; may Aryaman be kind to us.

verses.text: अन्नं बहु कुर्वीत। तद्व्रतम्।
verses.english: Make food plentiful. That is the vow.

verses.text: असतो मा सद्गमय। तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय। मृत्योर्मा अमृतं गमय।
verses.english: Lead me from the unreal to the real, from darkness to light, from death to immortality.

verses.text: दाम्यत दत्त दयध्वम्
verses.english: Be restrained, be giving, be compassionate.

verses.text: कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन
verses.english: Your right is to the work alone, never to its fruits.

verses.text: योगः कर्मसु कौशलम्
verses.english: Yoga is skill in action.

verses.text: यद्यदाचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तदेवेतरो जनः। स यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते॥
verses.english: Whatever the best among us do, others follow; the standard they set, the world pursues.

verses.text: न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते
verses.english: Nothing in this world purifies like knowledge.

verses.text: उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्
verses.english: Raise yourself by your own effort; do not let yourself sink.

verses.text: योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम्
verses.english: I carry the welfare and security of those who rely on me.

verses.text: नभःस्पृशं दीप्तम्
verses.english: Touching the sky, blazing with light.

verses.text: अहिंसा परमो धर्मः
verses.english: Non-violence is the highest dharma.

verses.text: धर्म एव हतो हन्ति धर्मो रक्षति रक्षितः
verses.english: Dharma destroyed destroys; dharma protected protects.

verses.text: चरैवेति चरैवेति
verses.english: Keep moving on, keep moving on.

verses.text: अयं निजः परो वेति गणना लघुचेतसाम्। उदारचरितानां तु वसुधैव कुटुम्बकम्॥
verses.english: 'This one is mine, that one a stranger' is the reckoning of narrow minds; to the large-hearted, the whole earth is one family.

verses.text: Manopubbaṅgamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā.
verses.english: Mind goes before all things; mind is their chief, and they are made by mind.

verses.text: Na hi verena verāni sammantīdha kudācanaṃ; averena ca sammanti, esa dhammo sanantano.
verses.english: Hatred is never calmed by hatred in this world; by non-hatred alone is it calmed. This is an eternal law.

verses.text: Appamādo amatapadaṃ, pamādo maccuno padaṃ.
verses.english: Watchfulness is the path to the deathless; carelessness is the path to death.

verses.text: Yathāpi bhamaro pupphaṃ, vaṇṇagandhaṃ aheṭhayaṃ; paleti rasamādāya, evaṃ gāme munī care.
verses.english: As a bee takes nectar and leaves without harming the flower's colour or scent, so should the sage move through a village.

verses.text: Udakañhi nayanti nettikā, usukārā namayanti tejanaṃ; dāruṃ namayanti tacchakā, attānaṃ damayanti paṇḍitā.
verses.english: Irrigators guide water, fletchers straighten arrows, carpenters shape wood; the wise shape themselves.

verses.text: Yo sahassaṃ sahassena, saṅgāme mānuse jine; ekañca jeyyamattānaṃ, sa ve saṅgāmajuttamo.
verses.english: One may conquer a thousand times a thousand men in battle, but the one who conquers himself is the greatest victor.

verses.text: Sabbe tasanti daṇḍassa, sabbe bhāyanti maccuno; attānaṃ upamaṃ katvā, na haneyya na ghātaye.
verses.english: All tremble at the rod; all fear death. Putting yourself in another's place, neither kill nor cause others to kill.

verses.text: Attā hi attano nātho, ko hi nātho paro siyā.
verses.english: You are your own refuge; who else could be your refuge?

verses.text: Sabbapāpassa akaraṇaṃ, kusalassa upasampadā, sacittapariyodapanaṃ, etaṃ buddhāna sāsanaṃ.
verses.english: To do no evil, to cultivate the good, to purify one's own mind: this is the teaching of the Buddhas.

verses.text: Ārogyaparamā lābhā, santuṭṭhiparamaṃ dhanaṃ, vissāsaparamā ñātī, nibbānaparamaṃ sukhaṃ.
verses.english: Health is the greatest gain, contentment the greatest wealth, trust the best of kin, nibbāna the highest happiness.

verses.text: Akkodhena jine kodhaṃ, asādhuṃ sādhunā jine; jine kaddariyaṃ dānena, saccenālikavādinaṃ.
verses.english: Overcome anger with calm, wrong with good, meanness with generosity, and a liar with truth.

verses.text: Sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā.
verses.english: All conditioned things are impermanent.

verses.text: Vayadhammā saṅkhārā, appamādena sampādetha.
verses.english: All conditioned things are subject to decay. Strive on with care.

verses.text: Sabbe sattā bhavantu sukhitattā.
verses.english: May all beings be happy at heart.

verses.text: Mā anussavena, mā paramparāya, mā itikirāya.
verses.english: Do not go by what you have heard, nor by tradition, nor by rumour.

verses.text: Caratha, bhikkhave, cārikaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya.
verses.english: Go forth, monks, for the welfare of the many, for the happiness of the many, out of compassion for the world.

verses.text: सव्वे पाणा पियाउया सुहसाया दुक्खपडिकूला
verses.english: All living beings love their lives, seek happiness and shrink from pain.

verses.text: पुरिसा! तुममेव तुमं मित्तं, किं बहिया मित्तमिच्छसि?
verses.english: Man, you are your own friend. Why look for a friend outside yourself?

verses.text: एवं खु नाणिणो सारं जं न हिंसइ किंचण
verses.english: This is the essence of the wise: to harm no living being.

verses.text: जो सहस्सं सहस्साणं संगामे दुज्जए जिणे। एगं जिणेज्ज अप्पाणं एस से परमो जओ॥
verses.english: Greater than defeating a thousand thousand foes in a hard battle is conquering oneself; that is the supreme victory.

verses.text: समयं गोयम मा पमायए
verses.english: Gautama, do not be careless even for a moment.

verses.text: अप्पा कत्ता विकत्ता य, दुहाण य सुहाण य
verses.english: The self makes and unmakes its own sorrow and joy.

verses.text: धम्मो मंगलमुक्किट्ठं अहिंसा संजमो तवो
verses.english: Dharma is the highest blessing: non-violence, self-restraint and austerity.

verses.text: खामेमि सव्वजीवे, सव्वे जीवा खमंतु मे। मित्ती मे सव्वभूएसु, वेरं मज्झ न केणई॥
verses.english: I forgive all living beings; may all beings forgive me. I am a friend to all and an enemy to none.

verses.text: सम्यग्दर्शनज्ञानचारित्राणि मोक्षमार्गः
verses.english: Right faith, right knowledge and right conduct together make the path to liberation.

verses.text: परस्परोपग्रहो जीवानाम्
verses.english: The function of souls is to help one another.

verses.text: हिंसाऽनृतस्तेयाब्रह्मपरिग्रहेभ्यो विरतिर्व्रतम्
verses.english: The vow is to turn away from violence, falsehood, theft, unchastity and possessiveness.

verses.text: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.english: One Creator. Truth is the Name. The Maker, without fear, without hatred, timeless in form, unborn, self-existent, known by the Guru's grace.

verses.text: ਮਨਿ ਜੀਤੈ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤੁ ॥
verses.source: Guru Granth Sahib, Ang 6 (Japji Sahib, Pauri 28)
verses.english: Conquer your own mind, and you conquer the world.

verses.text: ਪਵਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
verses.source: Guru Granth Sahib, Ang 8 (Japji Sahib, Salok)
verses.english: Air is the Guru, water the father, and the great earth the mother.

verses.text: ਸਚਹੁ ਓਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਉਪਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.source: Guru Granth Sahib, Ang 62 (Sri Rag, Guru Nanak)
verses.english: Truth is above everything, but higher still is truthful living.

verses.text: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ॥
verses.source: Guru Granth Sahib, Ang 469 (Asa di Var, Guru Nanak)
verses.english: I am a sacrifice to You who dwell in nature; Your limits cannot be known.

verses.text: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮੰਦਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਰਾਜਾਨ ॥
verses.source: Guru Granth Sahib, Ang 473 (Asa di Var, Guru Nanak)
verses.english: Why call her lesser, from whom kings are born?

verses.text: ਏਕੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਏਕਸ ਕੇ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਹਾਈ ॥
verses.source: Guru Granth Sahib, Ang 611 (Sorath, Guru Arjan)
verses.english: There is one Father, and we are all children of the One. You are my Guru.

verses.text: ਘਾਲਿ ਖਾਇ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਥਹੁ ਦੇਇ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਹੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਸੇਇ ॥
verses.source: Guru Granth Sahib, Ang 1245 (Sarang ki Var, Guru Nanak)
verses.english: Those who earn by honest work and share some of it with others, O Nanak, know the true way.

verses.text: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਬੈਰੀ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.source: Guru Granth Sahib, Ang 1299 (Kanra, Guru Arjan)
verses.english: No one is my enemy and no one is a stranger; I get along with everyone.

verses.text: ਅਵਲਿ ਅਲਹ ਨੂਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਬੰਦੇ ॥ ਏਕ ਨੂਰ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਕਉਨ ਭਲੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਦੇ ॥
verses.source: Guru Granth Sahib, Ang 1349 (Prabhati, Bhagat Kabir)
verses.english: First, God created light; all people are of nature's making. From that one light the whole world came forth, so who is good and who is bad?

verses.text: ਜਉ ਤਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਖੇਲਣ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥ ਸਿਰੁ ਧਰਿ ਤਲੀ ਗਲੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਉ ॥
verses.source: Guru Granth Sahib, Ang 1412 (Salok Vaaran te Vadheek, Guru Nanak)
verses.english: If you long to play the game of love, come my way with your head on your palm.

verses.text: ਦੇਹ ਸਿਵਾ ਬਰੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਭ ਕਰਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਟਰੋਂ ॥
verses.english: Grant me this boon: may I never turn away from righteous deeds.

verses.text: ਮਾਨਸ ਕੀ ਜਾਤ ਸਬੈ ਏਕੈ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਬੋ ॥
verses.english: Recognise the whole human race as one.
